title: Occlusion / Relational Denial
observed_structure: a person, object, or relation is repeatedly blocked by another motivated element
the obstruction belongs to the scene's causal space
visibility changes when the denied relation becomes behaviorally unavoidable
dramatic_operations: withhold relational recognition without obscuring events
cinematic_affordances: architecture or bodies blocking line of relation
partial object visibility recurring with increased exposure
foreground obstruction removed by consequential action
cultural_scope: general compositional pattern; interpretation must derive from established relations
transferable_structure: motivated obstruction repeatedly denies a relation until action changes visibility and forces recognition
non_transferable_surface: generic silhouettes, blinds, doorframes, or obscured faces without causal function
